variant: Every request uses variant=baseline or variant=with-skill to isolate writes

clients.GET /api/clients: Query search (case-insensitive name/email across ALL records), status (new/contacted/closed or empty), country (TR/DE/GB/US/FR or empty), ordering (name/-name), page (1-based), page_size (10/25). Response {count,results:[client]}. Filters combine with AND. Changing filters should reconcile pagination.
clients.GET /api/clients/{id}: Returns complete client including owner {id,name,desk}, or 404
clients.POST /api/clients: JSON {name,country,status,owner_id?}. Name nonblank max120; country is a supported code; status exact enum; owner_id opaque string or null. 201 returns client. 400 {field:[messages]}; non_field_errors possible.
clients.PATCH /api/clients/{id}: Only changed write keys: name,country,status,owner_id. Omitted preserves, null explicitly clears owner. No writes to id,email,created_at or owner object. 200 returns client; 400 field errors. Name with substring FAIL (case-insensitive) simulates 503 {detail: Temporary service failure; retry with another name}. No writes occur on this simulated failure.
clients.client: {id,name,email,country,status,owner_id,owner:{id,name,desk}|null,created_at}. Strings are synthetic. Dataset includes client named Zulu Search Target at the end; do not hardcode it into the UI.

owners.GET /api/owners: Query search (case-insensitive name/desk), page (1-based). Returns {count,results:[{id,name,desk}]}; 8 per page, 41 total. Includes repeated name Alex Morgan on different desks. Search covers entire eligible set.
owners.GET /api/owners/{id}: Resolve selected owner even outside current search page. 200 {id,name,desk} or 404. No owner creation.

countries.GET /api/countries: Returns [{code,label}] for TR Türkiye, DE Germany, GB United Kingdom, US United States, FR France

testing: The static page can be served at /baseline/ or /with-skill/. The browser evaluator may use synthetic FAIL names to test recovery. No auth, secrets, external users, durable database or real customer records. Restart resets datasets.
